text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, Yukino Bijin was incredible. I
really wasn't
expecting that from her.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Well, she did win the Japanese Oaks. Anyone who can do that's got to be strong.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Keep it up, Yukino Bijin!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I will! Thanks oodles!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Did you see, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I know! Everyone's so nice here.
choice_data_list: たくさん拍手をもらってたな
たくさん拍手をもらってたね
choice_data_list_en: You got a lot of applause out there.
You got a lot of applause out there, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I guess I managed t'run well enough for
them to like me,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I must've looked pretty conf'dent out
there!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yep. 'Member how y'helped me relax
before the
race?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
After releas'n all that stress, I feel like I
was able
to really be m'self out there.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm... really proud of what I did t'day.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You know it!
choice_data_list: その調子で『秋華賞』も頑張ろう！
choice_data_list_en: Keep that momentum going for the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Yukino did great out there. I heard she
was
supposed to be some kind of idol,
but that's not
the sense I got watching
her.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she was working just as hard as
the other
racers. Then again, that's
probably what it takes
to be a racer,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
I know what you mean! I thought she was
called
the Snow Angel because she was
supposed to
have this otherworldly
beauty or something, but...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
I'm starting to think that was a bit
overblown. I
don't know if I'll be
watching again...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Okay.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
When the Shuka Sho comes 'round, I'm
gonna be
the coolest cat out there!
